_comment: features/api/trading/trade_fixings.feature. The recording is the online fixings response (GET /trades/{id}/fixings/online) with data.fixings ignored: its dates fill as they pass ({} while every fixing date is in the future). The trade retrieved afterwards is checked instead: it holds the online fixings, and every schedule date up to today has a value for each fixing source. request.* below is read by that check, never sent (the case sends no body): fixingDates, the response path of the product's fixing dates when not tradeDetailsSchedule["Fixing Date"]; fixingSources, the response paths of the source names of a product with several (one entry per source in data.fixings)

FX_TRF._comment: No tradeDetailsSchedule: the reset dates of the instrument's schedule
